name: joint-hanger
title: Joint rig: hanger
orientation: Flat on the bed, either face down: one plain plate. One M5 button-head screw holds it on the beam's tapped end
description: A plate screwed to the free end of each joint rig beam, its top edge flush with the beam's top for the dial indicator's plunger, and a hole under the beam for the hook the mass hangs from. The hook hangs in line with the plate's middle, so the arm is the beam's length and half the plate. Sized by the M5 head and the beam's face, not the load: a 2 kg mass stresses it far under PLA's strength (load_margin). MEASURE.md, rows 34 to 36.

wide.rule: As wide as the beam's 20 mm face, so its top edge is the beam's top and the plunger lands on it

thick.rule: Three millimetres: an M5 button head's seat, and the least plate that does not bend under the hook

below.rule: How far the plate reaches under the beam's bottom face: room for the hook's hole and plastic under it

hook.rule: The hook's hole: an S-hook's wire or a loop of cord goes through

hook_y.rule: The hook's hole, half way down the part under the beam

round.rule: The plate's corners, rounded so they stay down

force.rule: The weight the rig hangs: a 2 litre bottle of water, 2 kg at 9.81 N/kg

net.rule: The plastic beside the hook's hole, which the hook pulls apart

tear.rule: The stress the weight puts on the plastic beside the hook's hole

shear.rule: The shear the weight puts on the two planes under the hook's hole it would tear out along

load_margin.rule: The weaker of the two, over PLA's strength (shear at 0.577 of it, one over the square root of 3, von Mises): the kit asks about twice
